Daler Mehndi - Koyalia (Official Video) | NS Chauhan | Ahmed Khan | Latest Punjabi Songs 2023
Daler Mehndi spins an Indian classical thumri in hindi and Punjabi with new age hip hop trap. Koyalia, a love balled, is Mehndi’s latest single to be released on 26th April 2023 by DRecords.
As always Mehndi showcases his musical prowess with a hummable sing along composition.
It is your easy listening lounge vibing track. The song’s lyrics are co written by Daler Mehndi and the maverick word weaver, artist, singer from UK, N.S Chauhan.
Credits
Album: Koyalia
Song: Koyalia
Singer: Daler Mehndi
